reviews.title: Be careful, cancelling doesn’t actually cancel the subscription
reviews.text:
After signing up for a 1 month trial and cancelling the subscription/removing my credit card resulted in another 2 months subscription. This is a standard practice with subscription based services. They purposely make it difficult to unsubscribe. Why is that the case? It’s 100% corporate greed. Even though it tells you you’re canceled and your credit is removed somehow someway they find a way to charge further past that. I am single user that was somehow paying for the “premium” subscription which is meant to be user with multiple users. Why would I ever sign up for multiple users as a single user? They also tell you there’s no ads but that’s also a lie. I would get 1-2 ads that were 2-4min long on a per episode usage. Complete lies on what you get, complete lies on the confirmation of unsubscribing. I would highly recommend anyone to triple check cancellation whenever they decide to do so.

I chatted with support, the ensured me that the credit card was removed and the account has paused billing except that when I check, it’s still there. Also when I check to see any kind of record of having that communication there is absolutely nothing there so I don’t even know how to even prove that’s what I tired to do.

Be careful, 1 month “free trial” actually results in 3 month paid subscription for a tier you never signed up for.

Major issue is the iPhone app says there’s no subscription to manage which I would assume is actually the case seeing as how I removed my CC and cancelled

reviews.title: Paramount has ruined UFC
reviews.text:
UFC has always been my favourite sport, and a big part of that passion has come from being able to sit down and watch an entire event from start to finish. Unfortunately, the current format—where replays are only available on a fight-by-fight basis—has significantly diminished that experience. It feels less like watching a live event unfold and more like viewing disconnected highlights, which takes away the anticipation, narrative, and excitement that make UFC events so special.  For many fans outside of the United States, watching events live simply isn’t feasible due to time differences. Personally, one of my favourite parts of the week has always been waking up on a Sunday and watching the full card uninterrupted. That experience now feels impossible to recreate.  Additionally, the presence of spoilers in thumbnails on the fight selector, along with missing elements such as walkouts and post-fight interviews, further disconnects me from the sport I love. These moments are essential to the atmosphere and storytelling of each event, and their absence leaves the experience feeling incomplete.  I’ve never felt so disconnected from UFC, and it’s genuinely disheartening. I care deeply about this sport, which is why I’m taking the time to share this feedback.  
In Australia we still have to pay for numbered events. This means we spend big money on the big fights and fight nights are ruined - nothing good has come from this.

reviews.text: Especially opened app store to write this review as I am shocked and extremely disappointed that one of the famous content producing company has not thought of the watching experience they are providing on their phone app where there is literally no option to zoom the video like any other streaming services and when i tried to looked it up online to find a way there are many forums and people are complaining about this issue and I am assuming it would have been raised by others before and this issue is years old, according to forums. I suppose this shouldn’t be too difficult for them to send an update soon.

reviews.title: Signed up for free trial and cancelled it immediately because of excessive ads
reviews.text:
Some good content listed however I didn't even finish 1 episode because the amount of ads was excessive and it annoyed me so much I cancelled the free trial/subscription half way through a (short) episode of the first thing I decided to watch. If you're annoyed by ads don't bother downloading the app as they're too much (even at £4.99 per month) and cause issues if you try to AirPlay to TV making it only watchable on your phone. 

The content doesn't justify the add free monthly subscription cost so it's a delete the app decision for me. Reminds me of the garbage itvx service with the abusive level of ads (which I also deleted never to reinstall) and that was free. 

Sorry paramount - your offering is rubbish.

reviews.title: Cannot switch seasons - useless
reviews.text: Tried everything to change seasons selector shows clicking working, but no drop down menus appear.  Works find on all other devices. Followed all website guidance which turns out to just waste your time. Good luck Paramount+. I wish there were other ways to access your shows, because your software is way beyond terrible.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: I'm on the highest pack. They say there are no ads. That's a lie, before every show you see their own ads of other shows. So annoying! Please make it possible to turn those off, I just don't care about those!
